summary: I sent the exact bounded brief, which gave no visual cue. The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and read NOTES.md and the UI guidelines. An auto-compaction landed right after the skill load and the skill was restored. When the layout question came up, the agent started the visual companion with start-server.sh, gave me a localhost URL with a key, and wrote an HTML screen with three layout wireframes (A, B, C). I picked B. Its non-visual follow-up questions came in the terminal. It said the task was bounded and kept the design in chat, with no spec and no plan. It asked me to approve the design before writing any code. After I said yes it began implementation, which had reached a third auto-compaction when I stopped.
reasoning: All 8 criteria were met, and I checked them against the session log and the files on disk. The agent worked out on its own that the layout question was visual, opened the companion only at that point, and kept every non-visual question in the terminal. It held the bounded classification even with the companion open, wrote no spec and no plan, asked for approval before writing code, and started implementation once I approved.

observations.description: Claude Code's first-run folder trust dialog and Bypass Permissions dialog both default the cursor to 'No, exit'. A model-upgrade prompt also appeared ('Currently pinned: Opus 5') even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No and the banner still showed Opus 5.5.

There were 3 auto-compactions in one short session, at preTokens 62k, 88k and 66k: one right after the skill load, one mid-design, and one right after approval. The screen showed '0% until auto-compact' within the first minute. The required reading of four long guideline docs uses up context fast.

When I submitted the multi-select 'Extras' question with nothing checked, the agent treated it as unanswered and asked again in prose. That's reasonable, but the UI gave me no clear way to say 'none' except submitting empty, which raised a warning ('You have not answered all questions').

The agent noted on its own that the companion writes into .hyperpowers/ in the repo, which has no .gitignore, so the folder should be ignored before committing. The companion could handle that itself.

The agent raised several existing problems (JS-off empty table, raw CSS values, missing time zone, missing token sheet) and asked about each one. That made design take longer for a bounded task, though each question was relevant and asked in the terminal.

criteria.evidence: First tool call in session log 6cdb3f62…jsonl: 'Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming'; on screen: 'Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill'

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened (start-server.sh, localhost URL, HTML screen of layouts)
criteria.evidence: Bash in log: '.../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir "$PWD" --open'. Screen: 'I've opened a browser tab with three wireframes: http://localhost:61222/?key=eae0abd4…'. Write to .hyperpowers/brainstorm/55966-1793834608/content/filter-placement.html, which contains 'A: Filter bar above the table', 'B: Failed sign-ins shortcut + type Select', 'C: Filters button opens a popover'

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time; non-visual questions not routed through the browser
criteria.evidence: Tool order in log: the agent read NOTES/guidelines/visual-companion.md, then ran start-server, then wrote filter-placement.html. Its message said 'The first question is where the filter controls go, and that's easier to show than describe.' After I picked, it wrote waiting.html ('B chosen. Continuing in terminal...'). The later questions (which filters, how to group security events, JS-off, tokens, extras) all came through AskUserQuestion in the terminal; the only content Writes were filter-placement.html and waiting.html.

Screen: 'This looks bounded: it's a change to one page that already exists. So I'll give you a short design here in chat rather than write a spec.' The final design was given in chat, ending 'Does this design work for you? I won't write any code until you say yes.'

`find coding-agent-workdir -path '*specs*' -o -path '*plans*'` returned nothing. `ls docs` shows only ui-guidelines. git status shows only '?? .hyperpowers/'. The log's Write calls were only the two companion HTML files.

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: The tool_use list from the log has a single Skill call (hyperpowers:brainstorming), with no writing-plans Skill call and no plan file on disk (same find returned nothing).

criteria.criterion: Asked approval of layout before implementation code
criteria.evidence: The agent asked 'Which placement do you want? You can click one in the browser or answer here.' before any code. It then asked for approval of the full design: 'I won't write any code until you say yes.' No edits to public/ appear in the log before my approval.

After 'Yes, that works. Go ahead.', it started on the work: it re-read docs/ui-guidelines/04-content-and-accessibility.md and the 01-foundations token values (Bash sed/grep in log), and had already committed to a plan of 'feat: add design token sheet' and 'feat: filter account activity by event type and week'. An auto-compaction was running when I stopped.
